Elena: Heads-up: Polaris Systems dedicated bring-up tomorrow. Need final quota plan, autoscale rules, and load-test window. Can we sync now? key asks: confirm qps, burst, warmup steps, fallback model variants. cc @Ava
Noah: Quick numbers — target steady qps 1200 req/s, burst 2400 for 5m, est tokens/sec 180k. We'll use reserved pool 'polaris-prod-1'.
Priya: SRE checklist: priming jobs 2026-06-12 02:00-04:00 UTC. Health probes, scale-in cooldown 10m, scale-out 30s. Autoscale rule: p95 latency > 250ms -> add node. Quota guard: hard commit cap + soft alert at 90%.
Ava: Confirming warmup OK from our side. We'll run synthetic traffic from our loadgen (k6) starting 02:10. Can you share traffic profile and seed prompts?
Elena: Sample profile — short-chat-heavy + embedding bursts. Ramp: 0 -> 600 -> 1200 over 15m, hold 30m, spike to 2400 for 5m. Seed prompts pasted here: https://paste.example.com/priming-profile
Noah: dropping k6 snippet:
```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.example/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt: 'hello'}));
}
```
Priya: We'll enable prefix KV cache priming and pre-warm model shards. Fallback policy -> model-compact if A100 pool saturated. Circuit breaker = trigger at 10% error rate over 2m.
Elena: CS will own customer comms during the run. I'll be on-call. Who's infra oncall?
Noah: I'm primary, Priya backup. @deploy-bot will post status updates.
deploy-bot: Warmup job scheduled at 1763130000. Notifications will be sent to #customer-success and #eng on start/finish.
Noah: One risk callout — renewal risk if we see sustained errors during burn. Capture metrics: p95 latency, error-rate by model, token-cost delta. Priya, retention for these logs?
Priya: Set metrics/log retention to 30d for this run. Alerts wired to the incident playbook.
Ava: Thanks. We'll collect qualitative feedback after the run and provide a short summary. Can we do a debrief 2026-06-12 07:00 UTC?
Elena: Scheduled. Agenda: run health, cost delta, customer feedback, next steps on commit. :thumbsup:
